phases.name: PH1
phases.description: CSA Phase 1 structural and steel-related works including FSA, DCH, EYD, MYD, RSA, SSA and site infrastructure.
zones: Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing Building
activities: Structural steel supply, fabrication and erection to EXC2, steel grade S355 (FSA, DCH, SSA, Cooling Tower Gantries, RMU/Battery supports, Generator/Cooling trenches).
Steel decking supply and installation (FSA, DCH).
Intumescent fire protection to structural steel (FSA 2 hr, DCH 2 hr).
Corrosion protection paint to C2 environment for Generator Trench and USS Trench steel.
Shotblast and hot-dip galvanizing to EN ISO 1461 for external steel (Cooling Tower Gantries, RMU/Battery supports, SSA structural steel) including surface touch-up after erection.

Design, supply and installation of holding down bolt assemblies / H.D.A. for primary steel frames (FSA, DCH, Cooling Tower Gantries, Generator/Cooling trenches, MCP, USS, S24, S25 and other equipment foundations).
Grouting steel bases (earthing/steel bases around FSA and DCH slabs; structural baseplates).
Miscellaneous primary steel items: internal and external stairs, gantry emergency stairs, cooling tower stairs, steps and ramps including handrails, railings and bumper railings.
Secondary steel for cladding support to FSA and DCH envelopes.

Metalwork and access steel: cat ladders and balustrades to penthouse roofs and between roofs; cat ladders for Cooling Tower Gantries; roof hop-over steps; roof railings and crash protection to rising services.
Steel bollards (perimeter, DCH/FSA yards, parking, loading docks).
Open mesh steel gratings for gantry walkways and platforms.
Roof metal decking to SSA (KINGSPAN RD100/825) and associated roof railings and cat ladder.
Safety fabrications supports for assembled stairs at roof level.
Supply-only of holding down bolt assemblies for modular plants (MCP, USS) and various pad/tower foundations.
Steel columns kickers/bolts for EYD foundations.
Security fencing on metal posts and steel fencing/handrails at loading docks.
Coordination of cladding/roof steel penetrations (steelwork penetrations, roofing penetrations, cladding penetrations) where they interface with steel frames.
Louvres requiring secondary/penetration steel supports, including smoke extract louvres added to roof.
Lightening protection 5x5m grids on roofs fixed to steel-supported roof systems.
Cycle route and site development elements where steel bollards or metal posts are included.
dependencies: Foundations, concrete slabs, and earthing mats completed and surveyed including H.D.A. and anchor bolt locations before steel erection.
Waterproofing and membranes to substructure in place where they interact with steel baseplates and penetrations.
Structural steel erection sequence coordinated with roof and wall cladding installation (secondary steel, penetrations, cat ladders, canopies).
Completion of Generator/Cooling trenches and utility trenches before installation of associated trench structural steel and supports.
FSA and DCH primary structural steel frames erected before installation of steel decking and intumescent fire protection.
Cooling Tower Gantry foundations in EYD/MYD completed before gantry steel erection.
Coordination with mechanical/electrical packages for locations of RMU/Battery Box supports, cooling towers, generators, steps/ramps and bumper railings.
constraints: Steel fabricated to Execution Class 2 (EXC2); all main structural steel grade S355; erection in accordance with NSSSBC 5th Edition.

External gantries and exposed plant steelwork to be galvanized to EN ISO 1461; intumescent paint systems to provide specified fire ratings (typically 60 minutes for trench/gantry steels, 2 hours for FSA, 2 hours for DCH).
Corrosion protection paint systems suitable for C2 environment for specific trench steels; galvanized systems for gantries and certain external structures.

Holding down assemblies from structural steel subcontractor are free-issue to civil contractor for casting into concrete; grouting in place is within CSA scope but must be coordinated with steel contractor.
Access steel (cat ladders, stairs, railings, hop-over steps) must comply with EN 14122 and project safety requirements.
Secondary steel for cladding/roofing must be compatible with specified Eurobond/Kingspan panel systems and roof build-ups.
Roof penetrations and cladding penetrations require close coordination to avoid clashes with steel members and to maintain watertightness and fire performance.
Security and RSA-related fencing on metal posts to be compatible with existing or new boundary conditions and foundations.
phases.source: Top-level: [Linha: 2] CSA PHASE 1; structural steel and accessories throughout lines 451–471, 642–660, 759–795, 773–795, 781–795, 789–795, 1037–1044, 2004–2015, 2062–2071, plus related steel supports, secondary steel and bollards in earlier CSA PH1 sections.

phases.name: PH2
phases.description: CSA Phase 2 works, primarily DCH building and MYD/EYD external areas, including additional structural steel, deck, gantries and associated holding down assemblies.
activities: DCH Structural Steel frame to EXC2, S355 including beams, columns and primary members.
Steel decking to DCH roof (TATA D60x1.2mm).
Intumescent fire protection to DCH structural steel (1 hr rating).
Holding down bolt assemblies and grouting to DCH steel frames.
Secondary steel for DCH cladding support (wall and parapet secondary steel).
Additional external site steelwork: cat ladders to penthouse roofs, bollards, stairs over roof parapets, small roof stairs.
Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel (Shell A) in MYD densified area including H.D.A., shotblast, galvanizing and surface touch-up.
Structural steel supports for RMUs and Battery Boxes across trenches, with galvanizing to EN ISO 1461.
Gantry access steel: cat ladders, cooling tower stairs, railings, 30mm open mesh grating for gantry platforms.
Supply-only holding down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS and S25 foundations.
Steps and ramps including handrails for Modular Cooling Plant and Universal Sub-Station access.
Grouting of steel bases associated with DCH PH2 slab and foundations.
Roof systems (Euroclad top deck) over steel deck structures, including lightning protection grids (load and fixing on steel deck).
dependencies: Completion of DCH PH2 substructure (foundations, slabs, earthing mat, formwork, membranes) prior to steel erection.
Casting-in of H.D.A. and RSA galvanized inserts coordinated with steel contractor before slab concreting.
Cooling Tower Gantry PH2 foundations in EYD/MYD completed before erection of gantry structural steel and access systems.
MCP and USS foundations completed including H.D.A. prior to installation of modular plant steel and access steel.
DCH PH2 roof decks installed before installation of Euroclad roof build-ups and lightning protection systems.
constraints: All structural steel to be fabricated to EXC2, grade S355; erection per NSSSBC 5th Edition.
Gantry and external supporting steelwork to be hot-dip galvanized to EN ISO 1461 and detailed for galvanizing (vents, drainage).
Intumescent systems for DCH PH2 must achieve 1 hour rating for indicated members and be compatible with shop primers.
Holding down assemblies free-issued by steel subcontractor; all coordinates and levels to be checked before casting.
Secondary steel for cladding must integrate with Eurobond panel and Kingspan roof liner geometry and joints.
Access stairs, ladders, railings and gratings must comply with EN 14122 and project safety requirements.
Lightning protection 5x5m roof grid to be fixed and coordinated with roof steel deck layout.
phases.source: Phase header: [Linha: 1045] S02-A1600 | CSA PHASE 2; core steel scope in lines 1127–1143, 1199–1219, 1311–1318 and related CSA PH2 foundation sections where H.D.A., RSA and grouting steel bases are specified.

phases.name: PH3
phases.description: CSA Phase 3 works including DCH expansion, MYD/EYD extensions, additional Cooling Tower Gantries and associated steelwork and access steel.
activities: DCH Phase 3 Structural Steel frame to EXC2 S355 including primary framing.
Steel decking to DCH PH3 roof (TATA D60x1.2mm).
Intumescent fire protection to DCH PH3 structural steel (1 hr rating).
Holding down bolt assemblies and grouting for PH3 DCH structural steel bases.
Additional miscellaneous steel items: external stair (Ground to Roof level) for DCH, bollards.
Secondary steel to DCH envelope (wall secondary steel, parapet supports) for PH3.
Cooling Tower Gantry PH3 structural steel including Shell A gantry, with H.D.A., shotblast and galvanizing; surface touch-up after erection.
Structural steel supports for RMUs and Battery Boxes across trenches for MYD densified area including galvanizing.
Gantry access and safety steel: cat ladders, gantry emergency stairs, cooling tower stairs, railings, bumper railings, open mesh grating.
EYD foundation slabs steel items: steel columns kickers/bolts for column bases.
Supply-only holding down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS and S25 foundations.
Steps and ramps incl. handrails for Modular Cooling Plant and USS access.
Steel louvres and smoke extract louvres associated with DCH envelope and SSA scope.
dependencies: Completion of DCH PH3 foundations and slabs including casting-in of H.D.A., RSA and earthing mats before steel erection.
Cooling Tower Gantry PH3 pad foundations and plinths completed in EYD/MYD before gantry erection.
MCP/USS foundations completed prior to installation of associated steelwork and access systems.
Roof decking installed before Euroclad roof systems and lightning protection grids.
Coordination of louvre and roof penetration steel with cladding and roofing packages.
constraints: Structural steel to EXC2, S355; erection to NSSSBC 5th Edition.
Gantry, trench supports and external stairs/railings to be hot-dip galvanized EN ISO 1461 and meet required corrosion class.
Intumescent paint systems to provide 1 hr rating on DCH PH3 steel where specified.
Holding down assemblies are free-issued from steel subcontractor; CSA package must coordinate casting and survey.
Open mesh gratings, railings, cat ladders and bumper rails to comply with EN 14122 and project safety specifications.
Steel columns kickers/bolts at EYD to be accurately set in PH3 slabs to receive steel columns in subsequent work.
phases.source: Phase header: [Linha: 1717] S02-A1600 | CSA PHASE 3; principal steel scope in lines 1484–1500, 1591–1613, 1690–1716 and EYD foundation items around lines 1556–1574.

phases.name: PH4
phases.description: CSA Phase 4 works focused on further DCH expansion and Cooling Tower Gantry phases, including structural steel and supporting foundations.
activities: DCH Phase 4 Structural Steel frame to EXC2 S355 including primary framing.
Steel decking to DCH PH4 roof (TATA D60x1.2mm).
Intumescent fire protection to DCH PH4 structural steel (1 hr rating).
Holding down bolt assemblies and grouting to DCH PH4 structural steel bases.
Secondary steel for DCH PH4 cladding support (wall and parapet secondary steel).
Cooling Tower Gantry PH4 structural steel (Shell A) with H.D.A., shotblast and galvanizing; surface touch-up after erection.
Additional gantry access steel: cat ladders, cooling tower stairs, railings, open mesh grating.
Supply-only holding down bolt assemblies for MCP, USS and S25 foundations in PH4.
Steps and ramps incl. handrails associated with MCP and USS in PH4.
Continuation of earthing and radon-related works in PH4 foundations that interface with steel bases (earthing pigtails, grouting steel bases).
dependencies: Completion of DCH PH4 foundations, slabs, membranes and earthing before steel erection.
Cooling Tower Gantry PH4 pad foundations and plinths in EYD/MYD completed prior to gantry steel installation.
MCP/USS/S25 pad foundations completed with holding down assemblies installed prior to modular plant steel and access steel installation.
Roof decks installed before Euroclad roofing and lightning protection systems.
Cladding secondary steel to be installed and aligned before final envelope panels.
constraints: Structural steel to EXC2 S355; erection per NSSSBC 5th Edition.
Gantry and external access steel to be hot-dip galvanized to EN ISO 1461.
Intumescent paint to provide 1 hr rating on DCH PH4 steel.
Holding down assemblies free-issued; correct placement and grouting critical to avoid misalignment of steel frames.
Access ladders, stairs, railings and gratings to meet EN 14122 requirements and be compatible with gantry geometry.
Lightning protection grid loads to be considered on roof steel decking in PH4.
phases.source: Phase header: [Linha: 1717] S02-A1600 | CSA PHASE 4; steel scope in lines 1803–1819 and Cooling Tower/gantry steel and foundations in lines 1873–1894 and 1895–1993.

zones.name: FSA
zones.description: Primary facility area (FSA) including foundations, floor slabs, superstructure structural steel frame, steel decking, envelope and roof.
activities: FSA structural steel frame to EXC2, S355 including beams, columns and bracing.
Steel decking to FSA roof (TATA D60x1.2 roof decking).
Intumescent fireproofing to FSA structural steel for 2-hour rating.
Holding down bolt assemblies and grouting of FSA steel bases.
Secondary steel for FSA cladding systems and parapet cappings.
Internal steel stair to FSA.
Loading dock fencing and handrails in steel.
Crash protection to rising services.
Cat ladder and balustrade to penthouse roof (ground to roof).
Roof hop-over steps and associated roof steelwork.
Steel bollards in FSA-related yards.
Roof Euroclad composite deck, parapet upstands, crickets and walkways supported by structural steel and deck.
Smoke AOVs on roof supported by steel decking and associated framing.
Lightening protection grid fixed to roof systems supported on steel deck.
zones.logistics: Requires crane access for erection of main steel frame and decking. Coordination of heavy lifts, temporary bracing and safe roof access for installation of roof panels, AOVs, lightning protection and hop-overs.
zones.source: Main FSA sections: [Linha: 358] CSA | FSA; [Linha: 451] CSA | FSA - Structural Steel; [Linha: 471] CSA | FSA - Envelope; [Linha: 536] CSA | FSA - Roof; plus SSA FSA AHU and SSA Louvres for FSA at lines 144–163, 2062–2067 and 2069.

zones.name: DCH
zones.description: Data Center Hall (DCH) including large foundation slabs, superstructure structural steel frames and steel decks, envelopes and roofs executed across multiple phases.
activities: DCH structural steel frames to EXC2 S355 for each phase (PH1–PH4).
Steel decking for DCH roofs across all phases.
Intumescent fire protection to DCH structural steel (mix of 1 hr and 2 hr ratings over phases).
Holding down bolt assemblies free-issued by steel subcontractor and cast into DCH foundations along multiple phases.
Grouting of steel baseplates at DCH column locations in each phase.
Secondary steel for DCH cladding systems including Eurobond panels and Kingspan roof liners for each phase.
Cat ladders and balustrades to penthouse roofs for DCH; stairs over parapets for roof access across phases.
External stairs (ground to roof level) for emergency egress.
Steel bollards around DCH.
Roof Euroclad composite roof systems for DCH in each phase, with parapet upstands and walkways.
Lightening protection grids on DCH roofs for each phase, fixed to deck.
Cladding and roof penetrations for services (ducts, pipes, cable trays) coordinated with steel frames and secondary steel.
Louvres (standard and high performance double bank) integrated with envelopes and supported by secondary steel.
Radon and earthing systems integrated with structural bases and holding down assemblies.
zones.logistics: Large multi-phase steel frame requiring phased erection and interface control between phases PH1–PH4. Survey of holding down assemblies and stub columns critical before each new phase. Roof works and lightning protection must be sequenced with ongoing data hall fit-out.
zones.source: DCH foundations and slabs: [Linha: 557–641], [Linha: 1045–1123], [Linha: 1397–1479], [Linha: 1718–1799]; structural steel and decking: [Linha: 642–660], [Linha: 1127–1143], [Linha: 1484–1500], [Linha: 1803–1819]; envelope and roof: [Linha: 661–696], [Linha: 1144–1178], [Linha: 1501–1539], [Linha: 1820–1862].

zones.name: EYD
zones.description: External Yard (EYD) including slabs and foundations that support structural steel frames and gantries; includes generator and cooling zones.
activities: Foundation slabs with cast-in steel columns kickers/bolts for superstructures installed by others (trestles, modular buildings, walkways/platforms, generators).
Cooling Tower Gantry foundations in EYD for PH1 and PH3 with numerous pad foundations, beams and plinths to receive gantry structural steel.
Supply and installation of H.D.A. for gantry and equipment support steel bases in EYD.
Steel bollards and protective railings in yard areas, particularly around cooling equipment and services.
External stairs and access steel associated with Cooling Tower Gantries accessible from yard.
Utility trench structural steel in EYD (from Perun to edge of EYD) where trench heads or covers are steel supported.
zones.logistics: Yard access for cranes and heavy equipment required for gantry steel erection. Coordination of trench works, foundations and backfilling with later erection of gantries and access steel.
zones.source: EYD references: [Linha: 7] precast road gullies in EYD (interface with yard slabs); [Linha: 243–260] FSA Air Cooled Condenser & foundations; [Linha: 350–356] Sitewide Utility Trench from Perun to Edge of EYD; Cooling Tower Gantry foundations and gantry steel: [Linha: 781–795], [Linha: 795–815], [Linha: 1613–1633], [Linha: 1873–1911].

zones.name: MYD
zones.description: Main Yard (MYD), densified water-cooled yard with extensive concrete slabs supporting large Cooling Tower Gantries, RMU/Battery trenches and modular plant.
activities: MYD structural steel gantries: large Cooling Tower Gantries steel frames in PH1, PH2, PH3 and PH4, including main steel, galvanizing and H.D.A.
RMU & Battery Box support steel sitting across MYD trenches (PH1–PH4) including galvanizing and touch-up.
Gantry emergency stairs, cooling tower stairs, cat ladders and railings on MYD gantries.
Open mesh grating on gantry walkways over MYD.
Bumper railings in front of chillers in MYD.
Supply and installation of holding down assemblies for multiple MYD-related structures: MCP, USS, CTB, USS trestles, S24, S25.
Fuel oil offloading slabs interfacing with steel pipe supports and bollards.
Steps and ramps including handrails for MCP and USS connections.
zones.logistics: Heavy gantry steel erection over large MYD slabs; requires sequential casting of foundations, then tower crane or mobile crane operations. Safety coordination for working at height on gantries and above cooling equipment.
zones.source: MYD references: [Linha: 165–186] Fuel Oil Offloading Area - EYD/MYD; MYD densified water-cooled structural steel and gantries: [Linha: 773–795], [Linha: 1199–1219], [Linha: 1591–1613], [Linha: 1873–1894]; MYD slabs and related foundations: numerous S02-A1100 and S02-A1600 entries where MYD is mentioned.

zones.name: Generator Trench
zones.description: Dedicated structural steel to form generator trenches including corrosion protection and fire protection.
activities: Generator Trench Structural Steel including primary trench beams and frames.
Corrosion protection paint for C2 environment on generator trench steel.
Intumescent paint for 60 minutes fire protection applied in factory.
Touch-up of coatings after erection.
Supply-only holding down bolts for generator trench steelwork.
zones.logistics: Steel prefabricated with coatings applied off-site, then erected into prepared trenches. Requires prior completion of trench excavations and any concrete works surrounding steel.
zones.source: [Linha: 759–765] S02-A7100 | CSA | PH1 | Generator Trench Structural Steel.

zones.name: USS Trench
zones.description: Structural steel for USS (Universal Sub-Station) trenches with corrosion and fire protection systems similar to generator trench.
activities: USS Trench Structural Steel including trench beams and support frames.
Corrosion protection paint suitable for C2 environment category.
Intumescent paint fire protection (60 minutes) applied in factory.
Touch-up after erection prior to partial handover.
Supply-only holding down bolts for USS trench steel.
zones.logistics: Parallel sequencing with generator trench steel; must coordinate with trench civil works and MEP services routed through trenches.
zones.source: [Linha: 766–772] S02-A7100 | CSA | PH1 | USS Trench Structural Steel.

zones.name: Cooling Tower Gantry
zones.description: Large elevated steel gantries supporting cooling towers, with associated walkways, railings, stairs and access elements over MYD/EYD.
activities: Shell A cooling tower gantry structural steel for PH1, PH2, PH3 and PH4.
Shotblasting and hot-dip galvanizing to EN ISO 1461 for all gantry steel.
H.D.A. supply and installation for gantry columns.
Surface touch-up after erection.
Gantry emergency stairs and cooling tower stairs for access.
Cat ladders, railings, open mesh grating and bumper railings for safe access and maintenance.
Pad foundations, beams and plinths designed to receive cooling tower gantry loads.
Supply of hold down bolts for gantry-related supports (MCP, USS, S25 and others).
zones.logistics: Requires significant cranage and temporary works. Gantry steel must be preassembled where possible, then erected onto accurately cast foundations with pre-positioned H.D.A. Coordination with plant suppliers for interface loads and access requirements.
zones.source: Cooling Tower Gantry structural steel: [Linha: 781–795], [Linha: 1207–1214], [Linha: 1599–1613], [Linha: 1882–1889]; foundations: [Linha: 795–815], [Linha: 1220–1236], [Linha: 1614–1633], [Linha: 1895–1911].

zones.name: MCP
zones.description: Modular Cooling Plant area with dedicated foundations, structural interfaces and access steel.
activities: MCP foundations (multiple phases) with H.D.A. cast in for future steel plant frames.
Supply-only of holding down bolt assemblies for MCP in PH1–PH4.
Steps and ramps including handrails for MCP access.
Integration of MCP with Cooling Tower Gantry walkways and stairs through steel interfaces.
zones.logistics: Foundations and H.D.A. must be complete prior to delivery of modular cooling units and any steel support frames. Steps/ramps installed after main plant is set.
zones.source: MCP foundations: [Linha: 873–891], [Linha: 1256–1274], [Linha: 1653–1672], [Linha: 1931–1949]; MCP holding down assemblies: [Linha: 1037–1044], [Linha: 1311–1316], [Linha: 1710–1716], [Linha: 1986–1993].

zones.name: USS
zones.description: Universal Sub-Station zone including plinths, foundations and steel access/hold down assemblies.
activities: USS foundation slabs, plinths and trestle foundations with H.D.A. for steel frames.
Supply-only holding down bolt assemblies for USS in PH1–PH4.
Steps and ramps with handrails for USS access.
Steel columns kickers/bolts where USS is integrated with EYD/yard slabs.
Integration with Cooling Tower Gantry where USS is adjacent or supported by gantry.
zones.logistics: USS foundations and H.D.A. must be in place and surveyed before steel erection. Steps/ramps and access elements installed later in sequence.
zones.source: USS foundations and trestles: [Linha: 892–910], [Linha: 1237–1255], [Linha: 1634–1652], [Linha: 1912–1930]; holding down assemblies and steps/ramps: [Linha: 1037–1044], [Linha: 1311–1318], [Linha: 1710–1716], [Linha: 1986–1993].

zones.name: CTB
zones.description: Cooling Tower Building (CTB) related foundations for trestles and plant supports interfacing with steel.
activities: CTB foundations and trestle foundations with cast-in H.D.A. for cooling tower related steel.
Supply-only hold down bolt assemblies for CTB (PH1).
Associated stairs, railings and grating where CTB links to Cooling Tower Gantry.
zones.logistics: CTB works coordinated with Cooling Tower Gantries; foundations and hold down assemblies must match gantry steel geometry.
zones.source: CTB references within S02-A1100 PH1/PH2 foundation packages; hold down assemblies for CTB: [Linha: 1040–1041].

zones.name: ASB
zones.description: Auxiliary service buildings (ASB) and their trestle foundations with steel interfaces.
activities: ASB foundations and trestle foundations with H.D.A. for steel structures.
ASB-related stairs and access steel where connected to Cooling Tower Gantry or MCC buildings.
zones.logistics: Requires tight coordination of foundation locations with future steel superstructures and gantries.
zones.source: ASB foundations: [Linha: 856–872]; ASB trestle references in S02-A1100 PH2/PH3 foundation zones.

zones.name: S24 / S25 Pad Foundations
zones.description: Discrete pad foundations (S24, S25) for equipment or steel trestles located within MYD/EYD/Earthworks domains.
activities: S24 and S25 pad foundations with H.D.A. for steel columns or trestles.
Supply-only hold down bolt assemblies for S24 and S25 across phases.
Any associated steps, ramps or railings linked to these pads via steel connections.
zones.logistics: Pads must be precisely located and cast prior to erection of associated steel trestles or equipment.

zones.name: Generator & Load Bank Garage (SSA)
zones.description: SSA Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing Building including foundation and small steel superstructure.
activities: (Shell A) Structural Steel to EXC2 S355 for Load Bank Garage & Fuel Polishing Building.
H.D.A. for SSA structural steel and galvanizing with shotblast to EN ISO 1461.
Surface touch-up after erection.
Roof deck (KINGSPAN RD 100/825) and roof railings and cat ladder.
Cladding panels, parapet capping and drainage components supported on SSA structural steel.
Foundations with H.D.A. and CRC coatings to support structural steel.
SSA FSA Additional AHU Foundation with H.D.A. for steel supports.
Under-slab insulation where interface to steel occurs (under FSA floor slab).
zones.logistics: Small but detailed steel building requiring integration of roof deck, cladding and drainage with pre-galvanized structural frame. Foundations must be completed and H.D.A. installed earlier in PH1.
zones.source: SSA scope: [Linha: 2002–2015], [Linha: 2022–2038]; additional SSA AHU foundation: [Linha: 2042–2057]; insulation under FSA slab: [Linha: 2070–2071].

zones.name: RSA Security Fence & Attenuation Pond
zones.description: Perimeter security and landscaping infrastructure with steel interfaces.
activities: 3 m high chainlink security fence on metal posts (no razor wire) around RSA boundary.
Timber fence and gate to attenuation pond (minimal steel; interface mostly posts and fixings).
zones.logistics: Fence posts may require small concrete foundations but are predominantly metal posts; installation phased with completion of external yards and landscaping.

zones.name: Cycle Route
zones.description: Cycle route in asphalt around or within site, including structural steel elements for safety where indicated.
activities: Construction of asphalt cycle route, including any integrated steel bollards, guardrails or supports that interface with CSA structural works.
zones.logistics: Cycle route works sequenced after main structural steel and heavy yard works to avoid damage; coordination required where route passes near gantries or equipment foundations.
zones.source: SSA - Site Development: [Linha: 2039–2041] CSA | PH1 | Cycle Route (Asphalt).

steel_scopes_overview: Primary building frames for FSA and DCH across all phases, including steel decking and intumescent fire protection.

Extensive external and plant-related steelwork: Cooling Tower Gantries, RMU/Battery supports, Generator and USS trenches, modular plant foundations, miscellaneous stairs, ladders, railings, bollards and gratings.
Secondary steel for cladding and roofing systems on FSA and DCH envelopes in all phases.
Supply and coordination of holding down bolt assemblies and grouting for a large number of foundations and pads (MCP, USS, CTB, S24, S25, gantries, SSA, etc.).
Access and safety steel elements including cat ladders, gantry emergency stairs, cooling tower stairs, hop-over steps, bumper railings and roof railings.
Support steel for roof-mounted systems and penetrations, including AOVs, smoke louvres, cable trays, piping and ducts through cladding/roofing.
Perimeter and external steelwork: security fences on metal posts, steel bollards and loading dock metalwork.
summary.concrete_exclusion_note: All pure concrete, blinding, reinforcement, membranes and formwork items have been logically ignored except where they create explicit interfaces with the structural steel scope (H.D.A., holding down bolts, grouting steel bases, RSA steel inserts). No concrete quantities or mix properties are included.
summary.method: Top-to-bottom scan of the BOQ CSV, filtering aggressively for activities, elements, and responsibilities that affect structural steel scope, interfaces, or risk. Phases and zones inferred from CSA code structure (e.g., S03-A2000, S02-A1600, S02-A7200) and BOQ headings. Only structural, decking, metalwork, fire and corrosion protection, penetrations, holding down assemblies, and steel-related access works have been retained.
